description:
Two functions scan .nix files with different exclusion rules:
- ConfigFiles::discover (config.rs:49): skips both default.nix AND common.nix
- collect_nix_files (config_scan.rs:71): skips only common.nix

This is intentional — default.nix files contain launchd services that need scanning (tested at config_scan.rs:240), but they shouldn't be config routing targets.

Add a comment in each function cross-referencing the other's behavior so future maintainers don't 'fix' the asymmetry:
```rust
// Note: ConfigFiles::discover also excludes default.nix (not a routing target).
// collect_nix_files intentionally includes it for package/service scanning.
```
title: Document collect_nix_files vs ConfigFiles::discover file exclusion asymmetry

close_reason: Removed unused PartialEq derive from SourceResult — no code compared SourceResult values with ==, all tests already used field-level assertions
description:
source.rs:14: SourceResult derives PartialEq while containing confidence: f64. The doc comment acknowledges this but the derived impl does bitwise f64 comparison which is unsound for NaN and fragile for computed values.

Tests correctly use (a - b).abs() < f64::EPSILON but derived PartialEq doesn't.

Options (pick one):
1. Stop deriving PartialEq, implement manually with epsilon comparison for confidence
2. Use ordered_float::OrderedFloat<f64> wrapper (adds a dep but is the cleanest)
3. Remove PartialEq from SourceResult entirely if only tests use it, and compare fields individually in tests

Least invasive: option 3, since PartialEq on SourceResult is only used in test assertions.
title: Address PartialEq derivation on SourceResult with f64 confidence

close_reason: PackageSource enum implemented with Display, Copy, Eq, Hash. All string comparisons replaced with exhaustive matches. 212 tests green, CI clean.
description:
SourceResult.source is a String compared against literals ("nxs", "homebrew", "brew", "cask", "nur", "flake-input", "mas") across source.rs, plan.rs, sources.rs, query.rs, cache.rs. A typo in any literal silently breaks routing with no compiler help.

Replace with:
```rust
pub enum PackageSource { Nxs, Nur, FlakeInput, Homebrew, Cask, Mas }
```

This gives exhaustiveness checking at every match site and makes illegal source values unrepresentable. The enum needs Display (for output) and probably FromStr/Deserialize (for JSON parsing in sources.rs).

Touch points:
- domain/source.rs: define enum, update SourceResult, SourcePreferences, sort_results, deduplicate_results
- domain/plan.rs: build_install_plan match arms (currently string comparisons)
- infra/sources.rs: all SourceResult constructors
- infra/cache.rs: cache key construction, source_to_input
- commands/query.rs: normalize_source_filter, source_values
- All test files that construct SourceResult

This also eliminates the redundant is_brew/is_cask/is_mas booleans on InstallPlan (see sibling issue).
title: Replace stringly-typed PackageSource with enum
